properties.name: selenide.base-url
properties.description: Provides the base URL for UI tests.

properties.name: selenide.timeout
properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds to fail a UI test.

properties.name: selenide.polling-interval
properties.description: Interval in milliseconds, when checking if a single element or collection elements are appeared.

properties.name: selenide.browser
properties.description: Which browser to use. Supported values: 'chrome', 'firefox', 'ie', 'edge', 'safari'.

properties.name: selenide.screenshots
properties.description: Defines if Selenide automatically takes screenshots on failing tests.

properties.name: selenide.headless
properties.description: Enables the ability to run the browser in headless mode.

properties.name: rest-assured.base-uri
properties.description: Provides the base URI for API tests (default is http://localhost).

properties.name: rest-assured.default-port
properties.description: Provides a default port for API tests (default is 8080).

properties.name: rest-assured.base-path
properties.description: Provides the base PATH for API tests (default is /api).

properties.name: rest-assured.csrf-path
properties.description: What is the path to get CSRF token (default is /csrf).
